name: Spring Love
source:
In this game you have to make Rea like you.
There are 2 good endings and 1 special ending. The other endings are bad endings.
Have fun!

[From [url=http://madicelady.deviantart.com/art/Spring-Love-Visual-Novel-364441592]DeviantArt[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你要让蕾娅喜欢上你。
共有2个好结局和1个特殊结局，其余均为坏结局。
玩得开心！

[摘自[url=http://madicelady.deviantart.com/art/Spring-Love-Visual-Novel-364441592]DeviantArt[/url]]
